description: Governance registry mapping artifact families to their provisional authority locations.
precedence_rules: versioned + schema-backed artifact > unversioned descriptive artifact
explicit policy matrix > adapter-local convenience docs
numbered taxonomy > unnumbered taxonomy unless explicitly grandfathered
explicit accepted decision records > implied practice

conflict_domains.description: Versioned 60-signals format vs legacy .signal front-matter format

artifacts.name: signal-lang
artifacts.notes: Versioned spec with deterministic parsing. Penalized for zero inbound parser references.

artifacts.notes: Numbered 00-90 taxonomy. Preferred over unnumbered legacy tree.

artifacts.name: agent-deck
artifacts.notes: Highest-confidence authority in repo. Strong inbound references and schema alignment.

artifacts.name: agent-contracts
artifacts.notes: Planner, implementer, reviewer, pi contracts. Shared across all adapters.
